Concrete outbound (export) rows seen: 2026-02-11 LUCKY-TECH MEMBRANES PRIVATE LIMITED -> 360ART, LLC, destination LOS ANGELES, UNITED STATES, HS 63062990, BOL 9573457, port SAHAR AIR CARGO ACC INBOM4; 2026-01-23 LUCKY-TECH MEMBRANES PRIVATE LIMITED -> TENTHOUSE STRUCTURES (PTY) LTD., destination CAPE TOWN, S AFRICA, HS 63062990, BOL 9017813. Buyer-side counterparties also listed: TRANSPORT HOLDINGS (Kempton Park, Gauteng, South Africa, 22 shipments), ZION MOUNTAIN RANCH (Mt Carmel, Utah, USA, 10), YARRA HOLDINGS (Mount Lavinia, Sri Lanka, 8), NOVARIUS TANK INDUSTRY LLC (UAE, 25). Source counter: page claims 516 total shipments / 10 trading partners / 18 ports; rows actually visible in the free view = 5 shipment rows (2 of them outbound exports, 3 inbound imports from Sioen Industries NV Belgium HS 39219099 and Forsstrom High Frequency AB Sweden HS 85159000).
note: Export side is factually confirmed by dated customs/B-L records with destination, HS and BOL numbers — not merely website claims. Note the declared HS 392190 matches the company's IMPORT lines (plastic film reinforced by fiber from Sioen Industries NV, HS 39219099), while its own EXPORT lines are HS 63062990 (tents/tent structures), so the declared code reflects inbound material rather than outbound product; per project rules this is not a rejection ground, only a code note. Domestic supply evidence (GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tenders, contracts, annual-report splits) could not be retrieved: web_search backend returned connection refused, and thecompanycheck.com, zaubacorp.com and indiamart.com returned HTTP 403/429. No GST turnover figure, tender award or contract is public in what I could read, so domestic_status = unknown and no number is invented. Revenue/export volume figures are not disclosed in the free view — null. Role appears to be manufacturer_trader (imports coated fabric, exports finished tent structures).
